stem.text: Why is it necessary for a person with a bacterial infection to take antibiotics at evenly spaced time intervals?

A.text: to increase the concentration of antibiotic slowly to a level which is lethal to the bacteria

B.text: to maintain a concentration of antibiotic in the body which is lethal to the bacteria

C.text: to prevent the development of resistant strains of bacteria

D.text: to select and kill the resistant strains of bacteria
